requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5567-7272-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-7272-8298--112.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
4550-5567-7272-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.

5147-7841--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Darksteel Angel
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4184-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
4184-6495-6972.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2835-3899-6249--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

4275-5003-5231-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
4275-5003-5231-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Repeat.

112-4050-6573-7639.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone three times this game.
112-4050-6573-7639.description:
Cast Clockspinning by paying {U} due to Font of Magic.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

4740-7345.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 51 or higher.
4740-7345.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Tamanoa triggers, causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat.

539-2244-4803-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4803-7297.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

2267-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

647-2366-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
647-2366-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-4875-5256-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4875-5256-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

413-539-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Bumi trigger, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

294-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-2478-2608.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Mishra's Bauble.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2478-2829-2866-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

560-2034-4593-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
560-2034-4593-6458.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and each opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-4593-6458.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

413-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
413-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Pitiless Plunderer and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie Druid.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

3334-3484-5391-6441.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3334-3484-5391-6441.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1570-6264.description:
Cast Sage of the Falls by paying {4}{U}.
When Sage of the Falls enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Sage of the Falls triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 3.

1429-4452-5330-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4452-5330-5402.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

2353-6033-6191.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2353-6033-6191.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

586-5231-5626-6112.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {R}.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

3192-4613-5212-5231.notablePrerequisites: Kresh the Bloodbraided has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3192-4613-5212-5231.description:
Activate Kresh the Bloodbraided using Ulasht's ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {R}.
When the Saproling dies, Kresh the Bloodbraided triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

2724-2921-3217-3582.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

859-2926-4613.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
859-2926-4613.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Traveling Minister's ability by tapping it, causing target creature to get +1/+0 until end of turn, and you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

193-2003-2247-4883.notablePrerequisites: Teferi has at least eight loyalty counters on it.
193-2003-2247-4883.description:
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two loyalty counters on each planeswalker you control.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a loyalty counter on each planeswalker you control.
Activate Ajani's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting a loyalty counter on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Teferi.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

2060-3129-3726-4929.description:
Activate Shalai by paying {4}{G}{G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

224-872-5233.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.
